source.citation: Hiemstra, T., Van Riemsdijk, W. H. (1996). A surface structural approach to ion adsorption: the charge distribution (CD) model. Journal of Colloid and Interface Science 179, 488-508.
source.location: Fig. 6 caption, Eqs. [18]-[23], the text on the charge distribution of the phosphate complexes (p. 501), Table 2

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), read on the page text
transcription.note: The goethite of the study: two proton-reactive surface groups of the 110 face, singly (FeOH, charge -1/2) and triply (Fe3O, charge -1/2) coordinated, both protonating once. Fig. 6 fits the charging curves in NaNO3 with the basic Stern approach, ion pairs in the d-plane. Table 2 gives the parameters of the phosphate data sets, Case III being the three-plane approach with the monodentate complex FeOPO3; its charge distribution factor f = 0.25 is stated in the text as half the value of the nonprotonated bidentate complex. The plane charges of the monodentate complex are derived from f by the paper's Eqs. [15] and [16], with phosphorus +5: Delta z0 = +1 - 2 + 5 f and Delta z1 = -6 + 5 (1 - f).

singly_coordinated_site_density.description: Site density of the singly coordinated groups FeOH(-1/2) of the 110 face (Fig. 6, Ns,1).

triply_coordinated_site_density.description: Site density of the triply coordinated groups Fe3O(-1/2) of the 110 face (Fig. 6, Ns,2).

specific_surface_area.description: Weighted mean BET surface area of the goethite preparations.

stern_capacitance.description: Overall capacitance of the Stern layer, basic Stern approach (Fig. 6; C of Table 2).

log_K_protonation_charging.description: log K1,2 = log K3,1, protonation of FeOH(-1/2) and of Fe3O(-1/2), from the PZC of the preparation of Fig. 6.

log_K_ion_pair.description: log Kc = log Ka, ion pairs of the electrolyte cation with the deprotonated groups and of its anion with the protonated groups, in the d-plane (Fig. 6, Eqs. [20]-[23]).

log_K_protonation_phosphate_sets.description: log KH of Table 2, the protonation constant of the goethite of the phosphate data sets.

outer_capacitance_three_planes.description: C2 of Table 2, Cases II and III, between the 1-plane of the solution-oriented ligands and the d-plane of the ion pairs.

log_K_monodentate_phosphate.description: log Kin1 of Table 2, Case III: FeOH(-1/2) + H+ + PO4(3-) = FeOPO3 + H2O, Eq. [7].

cd_factor_monodentate_phosphate.description: f of the monodentate complex FeOPO3, the fraction of the charge of phosphorus attributed to the 0-plane.

delta_z0_monodentate_phosphate.description: Change of charge of the 0-plane on forming FeOPO3: +1 (the proton) - 2 (the shared oxygen) + 5 f.

delta_z1_monodentate_phosphate.description: Change of charge of the 1-plane on forming FeOPO3: -6 (three oxygens) + 5 (1 - f).
